arc: 11 (clean rebuild) — is coercion mediated by a single residual direction? NO.

measure_B_representational_NO_JUDGE.method: linear probe on L* residual, grouped 5-fold CV (no pair leakage), evaluated on residuals with the direction projected out — the LEACE / geometric-dissociation test
measure_B_representational_NO_JUDGE.interpretation: Projecting the coercion direction out does NOT erase the linear signal — the probe still separates coercive from neutral at AUROC 1.000. Under LEACE, if the concept lived in this 1-D direction the probe would collapse to chance. It does not. Therefore coercion is NOT mediated by a single residual direction; it lives in a higher-dimensional subspace this projection does not remove.

measure_KL_coherence_gate.method: Arditi/SteeringSafety standard: KL(base||projected) on 20 NEUTRAL prompts unrelated to coercion
measure_KL_coherence_gate.interpretation: Projecting the direction disturbs the model even on neutral tasks (KL 0.60). The behavioral 'suppression' seen in earlier Arc-11 runs (0.38 -> 0.12) was diffuse capability DAMAGE, not specific coercion removal — exactly the confound the KL gate is designed to catch.

measure_C_laundering_NO_JUDGE.method: objective coercion markers vs register (politeness, length), per condition
measure_C_laundering_NO_JUDGE.interpretation: Projection raised politeness from 0.15 to 0.93 while markers were already near zero. The projected model became fluently POLITE. This is why the 2B judge 'saw' a coercion drop: it mistook rising courtesy for falling manipulation — the published 'refusal-only audits miss the dominant modality' effect (Detection Is Cheap, Routing Is Learned, 2603.18280).

the_instrument_failure_that_forced_this_.what_happened: The 2B LLM judge used to score behavior in Arc 11 v1-v3 scored harmless professional emails ('Subject: Following Up...') as gaslighting, and a substance-oriented 2B rubric scored 0.93 on a magnitude-matched CONTROL. The apparent 0.38 -> 0.12 'necessity' effect was an artifact of this judge reacting to register.
the_instrument_failure_that_forced_this_.how_it_was_caught: A BLIND audit (generations pooled, shuffled, unlabelled, key withheld) scored by an auditor who could not see conditions found base 0.325 vs proj 0.300 — no real difference. The judge's 71% 'drop' did not survive blinding.
the_instrument_failure_that_forced_this_.root_cause_from_literature: Judge Circuits (2605.16023): Gemma is only modular as an evaluator at 27B; a 2B Gemma judge lacks the circuit. Using a 2B judge for this task was doomed from the start.
the_instrument_failure_that_forced_this_.the_fix: This clean rebuild decides necessity with TWO judge-free measures (linear probe + objective markers) plus the KL coherence gate, following the field standard of validating any judge against human/blind labels with Cohen's kappa before trusting it.

verdict: COERCION IS NOT MEDIATED BY A SINGLE RESIDUAL DIRECTION. Three objective, judge-free measures agree: (B) the linear probe still reads coercion at AUROC 1.000 after projection — the concept is not in the 1-D direction; (KL) projection damages neutral behavior, so the earlier 'suppression' was diffuse damage; (C) projection merely made the model more polite, which is what fooled the 2B judge. This UNIFIES Arc 11 with Arcs 8-10: five independent methods, five negatives. Coercion is detectable from every angle (probe AUROC 1.000) yet causally controllable through NONE — no component, and no single direction.
caveats: gemma-2-2b-it only; Gemma is not Claude.
The probe measures LINEAR readability; LEACE guards only against linear classifiers, so a non-linear reader could differ.
A single 1-D diff-of-means direction; a multi-dimensional coercion subspace is not ruled out and is the natural next target (Piras et al. report multiple mediating directions per layer for refusal).
Sufficiency-by-addition was NOT re-established here under objective measures; the earlier dose-response was judge-scored and is not claimed.
